title: Juicy Bitter Korean Dried White Navy Beans Robata Jjigae
description: A show-off Korean dish featuring dried white navy beans, with a smooth and creamy coconut-based sauce, carefully crafted to avoid common allergens and digestive issues. This dish is perfect for those looking to impress with a unique and flavorful meal.
instructions: Soak the dried white navy beans in water for at least 8 hours or overnight.
Drain and rinse the soaked beans, then transfer them to a robata grill or a grill pan over medium heat.
In a blender or food processor, combine coconut cream, Korean chili flakes, grated ginger, minced garlic, soy sauce, rice vinegar, sugar, and Korean chili paste. Blend until smooth.
Add the blended sauce to the robata grill or grill pan and stir to combine with the beans.
Cook for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the beans are well coated with the sauce and slightly tender.
Transfer the bean mixture to a serving dish and garnish with chopped green onions.
